title: 'Honey-Glazed Spanish Chicken Crema Catalana'
description: Sweet, gooey, high-protein Spanish dish featuring dried chillies and a braise. Best served in a hot stone plate.
instructions: Season the chicken thighs with salt, pepper and dried chillies.
In a hot pan, heat the olive oil and sear the chicken thighs until golden brown.
Transfer the chicken to a baking dish and set aside.
In the same pan, caramelize the brown sugar and honey over low heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the milk, granulated sugar and lemon zest to the pan and bring to a simmer.
Pour the mixture over the chicken thighs and braise in the oven for 25 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Serve the Crema Catalana hot in a hot stone plate, spooning the honey glaze over the top.
Garnish with additional lemon zest and dried chillies if desired.
